boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UCR study settings in the Tomás Rivera and Orbach Science Libraries, spanning quiet floors, open seating, and reservable rooms.

cards.entity_name: Tomás Rivera Library Basement Open Study Areas
cards.title: Rivera Basement Open Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Tomás Rivera Library · basement
cards.notes: Choose window-side tables for daylight or move closer to the stacks for added privacy. Use the floor map before arriving to orient yourself.
cards.short_summary: An open lower-level setting with both natural-light seating and more secluded carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library describes Rivera's basement central open study areas as having large and small tables and semi-enclosed carrels, with seating by large windows or nearer the book stacks.
cards.access_notes: Open-study seating; consult the library floor maps and current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Tomás Rivera Library First Floor Lounge
cards.title: Rivera First Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Tomás Rivera Library · first floor
cards.notes: Set up at a café table or in soft seating when a relaxed, social-space setting suits your reading or independent laptop work.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor lounge that combines soft seating with café tables and chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library identifies the Rivera first-floor lounge as a social space with a mix of soft seating, café tables, and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Open-study seating; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Tomás Rivera Library First Floor Central Open Study Areas
cards.title: Rivera First Floor Open Study
cards.subtitle: Tomás Rivera Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use a table or semi-enclosed carrel, and take advantage of the public computers when you need a campus workstation for your work.
cards.short_summary: Central first-floor seating with tables, carrels, and public computers.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library says Rivera's first-floor central open study areas include large and small tables, semi-enclosed carrels, and many computers for public use.
cards.access_notes: Open-study seating; public computers are available in this area. Consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Tomás Rivera Library Second Floor Central Open Study Areas
cards.title: Rivera Second Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Tomás Rivera Library · second floor
cards.notes: Bring quiet work to the second floor and select a window-side seat or a carrel nearer the stacks. Keep conversation and devices silent.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor with tables and semi-enclosed carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library states that Rivera's second-floor central open study area has tables and semi-enclosed carrels and is reserved for quiet study only.
cards.access_notes: Reserved for quiet study only; silence mobile devices and avoid conversation. Consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Tomás Rivera Library Third Floor Open Study Areas
cards.title: Rivera Third Floor Open Study
cards.subtitle: Tomás Rivera Library · third floor
cards.notes: Use the available public computers or settle into a table or carrel; choose window-side or stack-side seating based on your preferred setting.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor open seating with public computers, tables, and carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library describes Rivera's third-floor open study areas as offering large and small tables, semi-enclosed carrels, and computers for public use.
cards.access_notes: Open-study seating; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Raymond L. Orbach Science Library First Floor Lounge
cards.title: Orbach First Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Raymond L. Orbach Science Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the soft seating or café tables by the large windows for a change of pace. Bring needed supplies, as vending machines are nearby.
cards.short_summary: A window-side lounge with soft seating, café tables, and nearby vending machines.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library describes Orbach's first-floor lounge as a social space with soft seating and café tables and chairs near large windows, with vending machines for food and supplies.
cards.access_notes: Open-study seating; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Raymond L. Orbach Science Library First Floor Central Open Study Areas
cards.title: Orbach First Floor Open Study
cards.subtitle: Raymond L. Orbach Science Library · first floor
cards.notes: Pick a large or small table, semi-enclosed desk, or comfortable seat; move toward the windows or stacks according to the work you need to do.
cards.short_summary: Flexible first-floor seating that includes tables, semi-enclosed desks, and comfortable chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library says Orbach's first-floor central open study areas have large and small tables, semi-enclosed desks, and comfortable seating, with seats near windows and stacks.
cards.access_notes: Open-study seating; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Raymond L. Orbach Science Library Second Floor Central Open Study Areas
cards.title: Orbach Second Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Raymond L. Orbach Science Library · second floor
cards.notes: Head to the west side for an individual egg chair, or use a table or semi-enclosed carrel. Keep this designated quiet-study floor silent.
cards.short_summary: A quiet floor with carrels, tables, and individual white-and-red egg chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library says Orbach's second-floor central open study area is reserved for quiet study and includes tables, semi-enclosed carrels, and white and red egg chairs on the west side.
cards.access_notes: Reserved for quiet study; silence mobile devices and avoid conversation. Consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Costo Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Tomás Rivera Library · fourth floor, Special Collections
cards.notes: Use the lounge seating, tables, or chairs for quiet work, and plan accordingly: food and drink are not allowed in the Costo Room.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Special Collections reading room with seating for individual or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library lists the Costo Room on Rivera Library's fourth floor as a public-use quiet space with lounge seating, tables, and chairs, suitable for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Special Collections Costo Reading Room | UCR Library
cards.access_notes: Public use; food and drink are not allowed. Consult Special Collections and library hours before visiting.

cards.title: UCR Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Tomás Rivera and Orbach Science Libraries · second and third floors
cards.notes: Reserve with a UCR NetID for a group of two or more, or use an unreserved room until its booking begins. Bring an HDMI-ready device.
cards.short_summary: Reservable collaboration rooms with tables, whiteboards, and HDMI-connected screens.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library offers 71 group study rooms on the second and third floors of Rivera and Orbach; rooms have tables, chairs, whiteboards, and HDMI-connectable TV screens.
cards.access_notes: Current UCR students, staff, and faculty may reserve with a UCR NetID; groups of two or more, up to three hours once daily.
